d9b2821c3d045dfb66d392dbca4f4029674a254d: A resort on a human scale, Macugnaga puts its emphasis on warm welcome and closeness rather than on impressive figures. Its 32 km of runs are a perfect fit for a 3- to 4-day stay, especially for families or skiers who don't need to constantly find new terrain. Macugnaga's family reputation is well deserved: dedicated beginner areas, well-groomed green runs and a laid-back atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Northern Alps for getting children started on skiing. With a summit at 2900 m and a village at 1347 m, snow reliability at Macugnaga is generally dependable from January to the end of March. A few exceptionally mild winters can cause shortages early in the season, but conditions recover quickly once the first decent snowfalls arrive. The day lift pass at 34€ remains reasonable for the quality of the ski area on offer. Counting accommodation, skiing and meals, Macugnaga suits those who want a good week without the final bill knocking them off their chair. In short: Macugnaga doesn't compete with the ski giants, and doesn't pretend to. It's an honest destination, often underrated, that deserves to be (re)discovered.
